Datacard Grok native-glyph test of Reflections Gold remaster candidates. [[A Gift (Reflections Gold)]] Undercover capital U and [[Old Smoothies (Reflections Gold)]] destiny 3 are on the canonical files. [[Looking To The Future (Reflections Gold)]] lore comma is still a candidate. Source list: [[Reflections Gold (remaster changes)]].

== 1. A Gift ==
Published. Game text uses Undercover with a capital U, matching [[A Gift]] and the Reflections Gold C1 scan. Donor glyph: capital U of Used on [[Strike Blocked (Reflections Gold)]]. The U sits on the same baseline as n, with ordinary letter tracking.

Canonical file: [[:File:RG-GEMP-A-Gift.png]]

[[File:RG-GEMP-A-Gift.png|400px]]

Approved candidate kept as [[Media:RG-Review-A-Gift-groc-test-v3.png]].

Card: [[A Gift (Reflections Gold)]].

== 2. Looking To The Future ==
Still a candidate. Lore should read behind them, it was time, matching the Reflections Gold C1 scan on [[Looking To The Future (Reflections Gold)]]. The comma is this card's own rebuild period plus a two-pixel tail, copied as ink only: paper and the orange lore frame stay as they are.
